functions.name: R4SYS.file_replace_atomic
functions.description: R4SYS transfers a staged FAT file into a target with a durable sibling backup and without a copy/delete fallback.

functions.name: R4SYS.file_delete_if_match
functions.description: R4SYS deletes a file only when its size, FNV-1a checksum and filesystem identity still match under one serialized filesystem gate.

functions.name: R4SYS.file_update_atomic_checked
functions.description: R4SYS completes or reverses one SYSUPD ownership transfer only after target, stage and backup fingerprints plus transient filesystem identities match a legitimate journal state under one serialized filesystem gate. The additive long_stage flag permits an existing FAT32 long-name stage for forward completion only; the backup and newly created target remain short names, and the stage short entry is durably detached before its LFN slots are reclaimed.

functions.name: R4SYS.path_names_equal_collated
functions.description: R4SYS reports whether two paths would resolve to the same object on their shared volume using the filesystem own collation (NTFS $UpCase, FAT32 ASCII case fold), so callers never mistake a byte-wise fold for identity.

functions.name: R4SYS.file_update_cleanup_checked
functions.description: R4SYS completes one SYSUPD per-payload cleanup with target, stage, current backup and previous backup bound together to expected identity, size and checksum under one serialized filesystem gate.

functions.name: R4SYS.file_stream_declare_publish
functions.description: R4SYS records the create-only publish intent of an already open stream, including which protocol owns it, so the durable claim brackets the whole transfer instead of only the final hand-over and recovery telemetry can attribute an abandoned stage to SFTP, SCP or FTP.

functions.name: R4SYS.module_resource_stat
functions.description: R4SYS resolves one embedded resource of an R4M0 module file by type plus index or name and returns its exact size without reading the payload.

functions.name: R4SYS.module_resource_read
functions.description: R4SYS reads one embedded resource of an R4M0 module file completely into a caller-owned buffer; a too small buffer is a visible error, never a silent truncation.

functions.name: R4SYS.program_module_path
functions.description: R4SYS writes the absolute module file path of the calling program into a caller-owned buffer, so a program can read its own embedded resources without a hardcoded second truth beside the manifest TARGET.

functions.name: R4SYS.program_module_running
functions.description: Returns one when a published R4X instance from the exact absolute module path is still running, zero when no such instance exists, and a negative program error when the query cannot be completed.

functions.name: R4SYS.monotonic_clock
functions.description: Reads the backend-stable monotonic nanosecond instant together with calibrated source and periodic-event metadata without reading the RTC.

functions.name: R4SYS.boot_ready
functions.description: Lets the active boot shell mark its first usable frame or prompt exactly once; repeated calls by that shell are idempotent.

functions.name: R4SYS.registry_snapshot_begin
functions.description: Starts a caller-owned, generation-keyed registry child-key or value snapshot without allocating kernel memory.

functions.name: R4SYS.registry_snapshot_page
functions.description: Reads one bounded registry snapshot page directly from the captured key range and reports restart instead of exposing mixed generations.

functions.name: R4SYS.registry_batch_mutate
functions.description: Validates and commits one bounded set/delete batch as a single registry generation with no partial visible mutation.

functions.name: R4SYS.io_file_write_at
functions.description: Starts an asynchronous, progress-reporting file write at an absolute byte offset without truncating unrelated data.

functions.name: R4SYS.io_file_info
functions.description: Starts an asynchronous metadata query; the terminal IoStatus result is the file size in bytes or an I/O error.

functions.name: R4SYS.io_file_lock
functions.description: Asynchronously acquires or exactly releases a caller-owned advisory byte-range lock; conflicts complete with io_error_lock_violation.

functions.name: R4SYS.storage_inventory
functions.description: Refresh newly registered devices and return a topology snapshot. All payloads are copied; no borrowed driver strings escape.

functions.name: R4SYS.storage_device
functions.description: Read one device slot from the exact inventory generation. Absent slots return zero.

functions.name: R4SYS.storage_partition
functions.description: Read one partition from the exact complete inventory; invalid or partial tables remain explicit.

functions.name: R4SYS.storage_volume
functions.description: Read one exact mounted-volume snapshot, including the internal boot alias.

functions.name: R4SYS.storage_claim_begin
functions.description: Reject stale, partial, protected or used targets before modification; close admissions, drain, flush and unmount, then return an exact logical-thread-owned exclusive claim. Failure returns no claim and performs no raw mutation.

functions.name: R4SYS.storage_claim_end
functions.description: Close raw admission, flush, rescan and remount prior identities unless KEEP_UNMOUNTED is set. A completed close consumes the claim even when I/O or remount fails; BUSY retains a finishing claim for retry. Failed targets remain visible.

functions.name: R4SYS.storage_read
functions.description: Read at most storage_raw_max_sectors from a complete validated target; concurrent exclusive claims return BUSY. The output buffer holds sectors times 512 bytes.

functions.name: R4SYS.storage_claim_read
functions.description: Perform bounded synchronous read within an active caller-owned claim. Buffer remains caller-owned for the call. An I/O error may follow partial hardware progress; never replay writes automatically.

functions.name: R4SYS.storage_claim_write
functions.description: Perform bounded synchronous write within an active caller-owned claim. Buffer remains caller-owned for the call. An I/O error may follow partial hardware progress; never replay writes automatically.

functions.name: R4SYS.storage_claim_flush
functions.description: Issue the durability barrier for an active caller-owned claim and report backend failure.

functions.name: R4SYS.storage_rescan
functions.description: Acquire the complete device, drain/unmount, reread its table and remount matching previous identities. Open uses reject rescan before unmount.

functions.name: R4SYS.storage_mount
functions.description: Probe and mount a complete partition with a fresh generation. Letter zero assigns the first free D through Z except reserved R; C and R cannot be reassigned through this call.

functions.name: R4SYS.storage_unmount
functions.description: Drain and unmount the selected physical volume and its aliases. Required runtime volumes and open uses reject the operation.

functions.name: R4SYS.storage_use_begin
functions.description: Acquire a real physical-volume use lease for a resolved path, including the system boot alias. File and directory handles hold this lease until close or logical owner retirement.

functions.name: R4SYS.storage_use_end
functions.description: Release an exact caller-owned volume use lease; stale or foreign identifiers are rejected.

functions.name: R4DRAW.gui_frame_cancel
functions.description: Discards the complete active build frame without changing the committed frame.

functions.name: R4DRAW.gui_frame_info
functions.description: Returns transactional GUI frame state and exact snapshot requirements. A null handle selects the current caller; a non-null generation-exact process handle selects that owner. GuiFrameInfo version 1 or newer with size at least 176 is accepted and answered as the supported v1/176 prefix. Version zero or a smaller size returns gui_frame_error_invalid without modifying out_info.

functions.name: R4DRAW.gui_frame_read
functions.description: Copies one immutable committed GUI frame into caller-owned command and resource buffers in one generation-checked operation. The handle is mandatory. Null payload pointers require zero capacity. GuiFrameInfo version 1 or newer with size at least 176 is accepted and answered as the supported v1/176 prefix. Version zero or a smaller size modifies neither out_info nor either payload buffer and returns gui_frame_error_invalid. On stale, buffer-too-small or other invalid input neither payload buffer is modified; out_info remains valid and reports the current owner, generation and required counts.

functions.name: R4DRAW.display_blit_xrgb32_stride
functions.description: Copies an XRGB32 source rectangle with an explicit source row stride into the display frame. source_stride_pixels must be at least w and pixel_count must cover the last addressed pixel.

functions.name: R4DRAW.display_present_regions
functions.description: Presents one XRGB32 source generation through the canonical bounded multi-region path and returns its synchronous fence and selected backend.

functions.name: R4DRAW.display_present_capabilities
functions.description: Returns the active canonical present backend, exact damage limits, formats and CPU fallback capabilities.

functions.name: R4DRAW.display_present_completion
functions.description: Polls completion of a canonical present fence. The current bootframebuffer and external blit backends complete synchronously.

functions.name: R4DRAW.gui_frame_begin_damage
functions.description: Begins a private transactional GUI delta frame for the current GUI program. The bounded client-local regions are copied during the call and describe every pixel that the appended commands may change. A successful commit retains the previous immutable generation as its base without cloning it.

functions.name: R4DRAW.gui_frame_generation_info
functions.description: Returns exact local counts, base generation, damage regions and telemetry for one immutable generation in the current committed chain. The generation must be nonzero and the process handle is mandatory.

functions.name: R4DRAW.gui_frame_generation_read
functions.description: Copies only the commands, resources and exact client-local damage regions owned by one immutable generation. Resource offsets remain local to the returned blob. On stale, buffer-too-small or invalid input no payload buffer is modified and out_info reports the generation requirements when available.

functions.name: R4DRAW.font_glyph_bitmap
functions.description: Copies one complete cached monochrome glyph, including its metrics and least-significant-bit-first row masks, after resolving the glyph exactly once. Missing glyphs use the same built-in fallback as the existing font renderer.

functions.name: R4DRAW.font_revision
functions.description: Returns the non-zero generation of the live system-font catalogue. Every completed catalogue reload advances the generation so consumers can invalidate font-id keyed caches even when ids or metadata are reused.

functions.name: R4DRAW.gui_frame_begin_replace
functions.description: Begins a private transactional complete replacement GUI frame for the current GUI program. The bounded client-local regions are copied during the call and describe every pixel changed from the prior generation. A successful commit publishes a standalone complete generation and supersedes the prior committed chain without retaining it as a base.

functions.name: R4DRAW.gui_frame_stream_info
functions.description: Returns bounded replacement-stream lifecycle and native XRGB32 transport counters for one GUI program. The process handle is mandatory and invalid caller headers remain unchanged.

functions.name: R4DRAW.gui_shared_raster_create
functions.description: Creates one producer-owned bounded shared raster with three reusable backing buffers. The returned generation-exact handle is destroyed explicitly or automatically at producer exit.

functions.name: R4DRAW.gui_shared_raster_destroy
functions.description: Closes one exact producer-owned shared raster. Existing immutable frame and consumer references remain valid until their final release; no new write mapping is accepted.

functions.name: R4DRAW.gui_shared_raster_map_write
functions.description: Reserves one currently unreferenced backing buffer and returns its direct producer-writable address and an unforgeable write token. The mapping becomes immutable when published.

functions.name: R4DRAW.gui_shared_raster_publish
functions.description: Publishes one exact write mapping as a new immutable raster generation. The generation may be referenced by a standalone full or replacement GUI frame until its backing buffer is reused.

functions.name: R4DRAW.gui_shared_raster_acquire
functions.description: Acquires one immutable shared raster generation referenced by the exact captured GUI frame generation and returns the direct consumer mapping plus an explicit lease.

functions.name: R4DRAW.gui_shared_raster_release
functions.description: Releases one exact consumer lease. A stale, foreign or duplicate lease is rejected without changing shared-raster ownership.

functions.name: R4NET.tcp_connect

functions.name: R4NET.tcp_write
functions.description: Writes bytes to an open TCP connection.

functions.name: R4NET.tcp_read
functions.description: Reads available bytes from an open TCP connection.

functions.name: R4NET.tcp_close
functions.description: Closes an open TCP connection.

functions.name: R4NET.tcp_summary
functions.description: Returns aggregate TCP connection and traffic counters.

functions.name: R4NET.tcp_connection
functions.description: Returns state and endpoint information for one TCP connection.

functions.name: R4NET.tcp_echo_listen_once
functions.description: Accepts one TCP echo request and sends its payload back.

functions.name: R4NET.tcp_accept_read_once
functions.description: Accepts one TCP client and reads its first payload.

functions.name: R4NET.net_ipv4_send
functions.description: Sends one IPv4 payload through the configured network stack.

functions.name: R4NET.net_ipv4_recv
functions.description: Receives one queued IPv4 payload.

functions.name: R4NET.net_config_get
functions.description: Returns the active IPv4 network configuration.

functions.name: R4NET.net_config_set
functions.description: Applies an IPv4 network configuration.

functions.name: R4NET.net_dns_resolve
functions.description: Resolves a host name using the configured DNS server.

functions.name: R4NET.net_dns_resolve_server
functions.description: Resolves a host name using an explicitly selected DNS server.

functions.name: R4NET.net_dhcp_acquire
functions.description: Starts or performs DHCP lease acquisition.

functions.name: R4NET.net_dhcp_renew
functions.description: Renews the active DHCP lease.

functions.name: R4NET.net_dhcp_release
functions.description: Releases the active DHCP lease.

functions.name: R4NET.net_dhcp_status
functions.description: Returns DHCP coordinator and lease state.

functions.name: R4NET.net_detail_get
functions.description: Returns detailed adapter and IPv4 stack information.

functions.name: R4NET.net_diag_run
functions.description: Runs the bounded network diagnostic suite.

functions.name: R4NET.ipc_open
functions.description: Opens a named local IPC channel.

functions.name: R4NET.ipc_send
functions.description: Sends one message through a local IPC channel.

functions.name: R4NET.ipc_recv
functions.description: Receives one message from a local IPC channel.

functions.name: R4NET.ipc_poll

functions.name: R4NET.ipc_close
functions.description: Closes a local IPC channel.

functions.name: R4NET.ipc_summary
functions.description: Returns aggregate local IPC channel statistics.

functions.name: R4NET.ipc_channel
functions.description: Returns state and counters for one local IPC channel.

functions.name: R4NET.serial_link_status
functions.description: Returns serial-link connection and transfer state.

functions.name: R4NET.serial_link_poll
functions.description: Polls the serial link for newly received messages.

functions.name: R4NET.serial_link_send_message
functions.description: Sends one framed message over the serial link.

functions.name: R4NET.serial_link_host_test
functions.description: Runs the serial-link host interoperability probe.

functions.name: R4NET.serial_link_inbox
functions.description: Reads one message from the serial-link inbox.

functions.name: R4NET.net_service_request
functions.description: Runs one network-service request through the generation-bound kernel channel worker and returns only its matching response.

functions.name: R4NET.ipc_performance
functions.description: Returns append-only kernel-channel worker, byte-work, queue, wait and timing counters for one channel or channel zero for the aggregate.

functions.name: R4NET.tcp_performance
functions.description: Returns append-only TCP write-burst, outstanding-data, ACK-coalescing, polling, retransmit and negotiated-option counters.

functions.name: R4AUDIO.audio_open_stream
functions.description: Opens an owned PCM output stream with the requested format.

functions.name: R4AUDIO.audio_write
functions.description: Writes PCM frames to an open audio stream.

functions.name: R4AUDIO.audio_close
functions.description: Drains all accepted PCM frames, then closes and invalidates an owned audio stream; a failed drain keeps the handle valid for retry.

functions.name: R4AUDIO.audio_set_volume
functions.description: Sets the volume of an open audio stream.

functions.name: R4AUDIO.sid_acquire
functions.description: Acquires exclusive access to a SID synthesis voice.

functions.name: R4AUDIO.sid_write_register
functions.description: Writes one register of an acquired SID synthesizer.

functions.name: R4AUDIO.sid_release
functions.description: Releases an acquired SID synthesizer.

functions.name: R4AUDIO.sid_load_data
functions.description: Loads SID tune data into the synthesis service.

functions.name: R4AUDIO.sid_init
functions.description: Initializes a loaded SID tune at the requested subsong.

functions.name: R4AUDIO.sid_play_frame
functions.description: Renders or advances one SID playback frame.

functions.name: R4AUDIO.sid_stop
functions.description: Stops active SID tune playback.

functions.name: R4AUDIO.sid_model_name
functions.description: Returns the display name of a SID chip model.

functions.name: R4AUDIO.midi_open_synth
functions.description: Opens an owned MIDI synthesizer session.

functions.name: R4AUDIO.midi_send
functions.description: Sends MIDI bytes to an open synthesizer session. Status zero renders PCM; data1/data2 carry the little-endian frame count (1..1024), while zero selects 1024 frames. Backend and backpressure errors are returned unchanged.

functions.name: R4AUDIO.midi_close
functions.description: Closes and invalidates an owned MIDI synthesizer session.

functions.name: R4AUDIO.opl3_write_register
functions.description: Writes one OPL3 hardware or emulation register.

functions.name: R4AUDIO.opl3_reset
functions.description: Resets all OPL3 channels and registers.

functions.name: R4AUDIO.opl3_render_block
functions.description: Renders one block of OPL3 PCM samples.

functions.name: R4AUDIO.opl3_stop
functions.description: Stops OPL3 playback and silences active voices.

functions.name: R4DEV.device_inventory_summary
functions.description: Returns the number and revision of inventoried hardware devices.

functions.name: R4DEV.device_inventory_record
functions.description: Returns one hardware device inventory record.

functions.name: R4DEV.memory_summary
functions.description: Returns physical memory totals and allocator usage.

functions.name: R4DEV.memory_block_count
functions.description: Returns the number of physical memory-map blocks.

functions.name: R4DEV.memory_block

functions.name: R4DEV.memory_pressure_snapshot
functions.description: Returns current reclaim, cache, and memory-pressure counters.

functions.name: R4DEV.memory_reclaim_probe
functions.description: Runs a bounded memory reclaim diagnostic.

functions.name: R4DEV.memory_backing_store_probe
functions.description: Runs the backing-store availability diagnostic.

functions.name: R4DEV.memory_backing_store_slot_probe
functions.description: Runs the backing-store slot allocation diagnostic.

functions.name: R4DEV.memory_pager_gate_probe
functions.description: Runs the pager admission and blocker diagnostic.

functions.name: R4DEV.memory_page_io_probe

functions.name: R4DEV.memory_vm_reserve_probe

functions.name: R4DEV.paging_summary
functions.description: Returns paging, residency, and page-fault counters.

functions.name: R4DEV.performance_summary
functions.description: Returns aggregate scheduler, storage, boot, and calibrated clock counters. The caller supplies its supported ProgramPerformanceSummary version and byte size; the provider writes only the negotiated append-only prefix.

functions.name: R4DEV.performance_task

functions.name: R4DEV.performance_storage
functions.description: Returns performance counters for one storage device.

functions.name: R4DEV.performance_boot_phase
functions.description: Returns timing data for one boot phase.

functions.name: R4DEV.protocol_status
functions.description: Returns load and runtime state for one protocol module.

functions.name: R4DEV.protocol_dispatch
functions.description: Dispatches a diagnostic or control operation to a protocol module.

functions.name: R4DEV.display_summary
functions.description: Returns display backend, mode, cache, and presentation statistics.

functions.name: R4DEV.hardware_summary
functions.description: Returns a compact summary of discovered platform hardware.

functions.name: R4DEV.boot_info_summary
functions.description: Returns bootloader response and platform discovery summary data.

functions.name: R4DEV.boot_info_memory_count
functions.description: Returns the number of boot memory-map entries.

functions.name: R4DEV.boot_info_memory_entry
functions.description: Returns one boot memory-map entry.

functions.name: R4DEV.program_instance_storage_summary
functions.description: Legacy v1 storage summary output. The provider never reads the incoming header, writes exactly the frozen 256-byte v1 prefix and leaves bytes after that prefix untouched, preserving callers built with the original C facade.

functions.name: R4DEV.program_instance_storage_self_test
functions.description: Runs the bounded dynamic program-instance storage diagnostic.

functions.name: R4DEV.program_registry_summary
functions.description: Returns compatibility summary data for the dynamic program registry.

functions.name: R4DEV.program_registry_self_test
functions.description: Runs the compatibility dynamic program-registry diagnostic.

functions.name: R4DEV.program_registry_summary_v2
functions.description: Returns full lifecycle and allocation data for the dynamic program registry.

functions.name: R4DEV.program_registry_self_test_v2
functions.description: Runs the full program-lifecycle and dynamic-registry diagnostic.

functions.name: R4DEV.execution_inventory_summary
functions.description: R4DEV returns the compact generation-safe program, task, and thread inventory summary.

functions.name: R4DEV.program_instance_storage_summary_v2
functions.description: Returns the complete current v2/336-byte dynamic program-instance storage summary, including transactional GUI-frame telemetry. Caller versions 2 or newer with size at least 336 are accepted and answered as v2/336; version zero, version 1 or a smaller size returns -1 without modifying the buffer.

functions.name: R4DEV.kernel_version
functions.description: Returns the semantic version of the currently running kernel from its embedded ELF metadata source.

functions.name: R4DEV.performance_boot_phase_clock
functions.description: Returns the calibrated nanosecond timing and explicit availability state for one recorded boot phase; endpoint clock metadata is frozen after terminal boot completion.

functions.name: R4DEV.performance_irq_timing
functions.description: Returns IRQ-router dispatch and external-handler nanosecond timing with explicit coverage and observer-read counts.

functions.name: R4DEV.performance_boot_summary
functions.description: Returns the small passive boot completion and frozen timing dataset without collecting broad subsystem summaries.

functions.name: R4DEV.performance_driver_work
functions.description: Returns the compact owner-selectable driver-work queue state, timing, wake, release, scan, critical-section and cleanup counters without collecting broad subsystem summaries.

functions.name: R4DEV.performance_pci_inventory
functions.description: Returns the compact canonical PCI inventory coverage, bounded-enumeration, config-access, mapping and consumer-materialization counters.

functions.name: R4DEV.performance_input
functions.description: Returns compact i8042, keyboard, GUI-event, console-input and program-entry queue counters.
